annotations.title: Learn the faith from the house's own pages

description: The house's own pages on the faith: the gospel, beliefs, parables, miracles, hymns, a prayer for a situation, a hard season, saints, the church year, the meaning of a name, other faiths. Pick a mode. Example: {mode:"a_prayer_for", subject:"a friend who is sick"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/learn_the_faith. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

compare_with.description: For compare_traditions: the second denomination, e.g. "Eastern Orthodox Church".

date.description: For saint_of_the_day: "October 4", "4 Oct" or YYYY-MM-DD; the year is ignored.

kind.description: For heritage: which kind of entity subject names.

mode.description: The kind of answer. Leave out for a guide to the modes.

subject.description: The one thing asked about, in plain words: a doctrine, parable, miracle, hymn.

year.description: For church_year: the year, 1900 to 2099; read from subject when omitted, default the next one ahead.
